issues.title: Common time interval in the all-order prefactor-free derivative estimate
issues.source_location: Theorem 1.2, PDF/printed page 4, equation (1.7); final proof on PDF/printed page 30.
issues.claim_under_review: For every derivative order k, an exponent C_k>0 gives |D^k h(t)| <= exp(-C_k/t) throughout one already fixed interval (0,T_0].
issues.checked_calculation: Fixed-order interpolation yields A_k t^{-m_k} exp(-a_k/t). For each fixed k it can be absorbed after restricting to T_k. The scalar function f(x,t)=exp(-1/t)/(1-x), |x|<1/2, has D_x^k f(0,t)=k!exp(-1/t): all fixed orders have exponential decay, but at any positive t their values are unbounded in k. This proves that the quoted estimates alone do not imply the common-time prefactor-free bound.
issues.counterevidence: The diagnostic is not a Ricci-flow counterexample and does not incorporate existential gauge choice. Additional PDE structure could establish the stronger conclusion. The C0 estimate and finite derivative orders needed in Section 8 remain supported.
issues.core_impact: Unresolved strength of the all-orders quantifier; no false geometric theorem or failure of compact-or-flat application established.
issues.repair_boundary: An order-dependent prefactor, or a separate T_k>0, follows from the checked interpolation. Whether the printed common-time form holds needs an additional argument. No author adoption claimed.

excluded_literal_discrepancies.description: Time index in distance-distortion factor; static Euclidean diagnostic refutes the literal index but correct standard factor is used elsewhere. No substantive downstream effect established.
Annular separation coefficient 3/16 replaced safely by 1/16; unspecified positive Gaussian exponent and qualitative conclusion survive.
Fixed integration prefactor and cone-volume denominator slips do not alter the required qualitative decay or positive volume lower bound.
Transverse-distance constant and Busemann sign slips are bypassed by an explicit valid product-space excess estimate and opposite Busemann functions.

per_problem.classification: Needs Evidence; no confirmed Major or Minor
per_problem.source: Exact arXiv:2203.15313v2, PDF p.4 Theorem 1.2(1.7), pp.24-27 (5.9)-(5.12) and Corollary 5.4, pp.28-30 Theorem 6.2 and proof of Theorem 1.2
per_problem.verdict: The report accurately identifies an unresolved quantifier/prefactor gap in the displayed proof, not a counterexample to Ricci flow.
per_problem.independent_reasoning: The statement first chooses a common T0 and then, for every derivative order k, a positive Ck with prefactor one in exp(-Ck/t). The actual interpolation inequality (5.9) and interior derivative estimates supply, at each fixed order, an order-dependent constant and a polynomial power of t multiplying an exponential. For any fixed k one can absorb those factors on a sufficiently short interval Tk; the displayed argument does not establish a positive interval uniform in all k. Corollary 5.4 explicitly has constants Cj,k and order-dependent shrinking times, and does not provide the missing uniformity.
per_problem.witness_check: For f(x,t)=exp(-1/t)/(1-x), |x|<1/2, one has D_x^k f(0,t)=k! exp(-1/t). Every fixed derivative has exponential smallness as t tends to zero, whereas for every fixed positive t these values are unbounded in k and cannot all be bounded by exp(-Ck/t)<1. This verifies the logical distinction only. The function is not claimed to solve the Ricci-DeTurck equation or satisfy the geometric hypotheses.
per_problem.counterevidence_and_scope: The gauges in the theorem are existential and extra PDE information may prove the stronger estimate. No geometric counterexample or impossibility of alternative gauges has been established. The C0 exponential rate and any finite collection of derivative orders are not refuted, nor is the three-dimensional rigidity application. Keeping Needs Evidence is necessary.
per_problem.repair: State order-dependent prefactors on a common time interval, allow order-dependent smaller intervals, or supply a new uniform-in-order argument for the exact printed bound.

per_problem.verdict: No issue-free theorem certification is inferred from the absence of confirmed Major/Minor findings.
per_problem.independent_reasoning: The report distinguishes local flows, which need not have complete time slices but satisfy the compact-containment and local hypotheses (1.1)-(1.5), from the complete bounded-curvature hypotheses of the global three-dimensional statement. Ricci lower bounds, c/t curvature control, common limiting distance, Reifenberg/coordinate assumptions, and nonnegative Ricci in the pinching condition are retained. The annular-distance constant discrepancy in the p.29 estimate affects an unspecified positive exponent and is not promoted to a substantive defect.
per_problem.external_dependencies: Compactness, heat-kernel estimates, Bernstein-Shi estimates and the cited rigidity results remain named external inputs, not newly reproved results.

focused_independent_acceptance.scope_conclusion: Focused independent acceptance of the existing report is complete. Its sole unresolved issue is correctly labeled Needs Evidence and confined to the all-orders quantifier with unit prefactor. No confirmed mathematical defect or counterexample to the geometric main theorems is asserted. Exact author v2 is retained without assuming equivalence to the journal version.
